info.title: Imagination Is All You Need API
info.description: Local API of Imagination Is All You Need (open rebuild on ComfyUI; not affiliated with Higgsfield). Mock backend by default. Prices are in credits (1 credit = $0.01).

get.summary: Health, backend, retention days, queue lanes

Image workflow recipes for Create Image's Workflow picker and strip (shared/workflows.ts): {categories, workflows[{id, name, defaults {local, hosted, localLight?, why {local?, hosted?}, note?, active {id, setup local | hosted, runs, reason, why, source pin | editorial | fallback, defaultProvider (what the bar starts on with no saved pick), note} | null} (per-workflow default models, shared/imageDefaults.ts; local null = no local route wired), icon, category (edit | people | product | camera), tagline, needs ("1 photo", "2 photos", "Photo optional"), source {kind ours | official | community, author, url, licence, file, note}, runner {kind create-image, toolId (the app-* tool that runs it; ids never change)}, slots[{name, label, required, sendsAs, order, hint, missing}], groups[{id, label, icon, summary}], controls[{field, label, kind select | tiles | grid | pad | segmented | slider | toggle | swatches | text | chips-multi, group, options?, default?, min?, max?, step?, pattern?, optional?}], prompt {mode required | optional | hidden, placeholder, composer}, modes {default, whenSlot}, models {mode: provider ids that can run the recipe as locked: the same check as its /price}, unavailable {mode: [{id, reason}]} (the tool's other models, greyed in the menu with the reason), modelInfo {providerId: {name, workflow {line, url, source}}}, output {aspect, resolution, count}, locked, surface mask | multi-output | rig | null, generateLabel, aliases {toolId, routes}, status ready | soon, route}]}. Submit and quote with the runner tool (POST /api/tools/{toolId}/jobs, GET /api/tools/{toolId}/price). Cache-friendly: ETag and max-age=60; If-None-Match → 304.

Audio workflow recipes for the one Audio page (shared/audioWorkflows.ts), same shape as /api/image-workflows: {categories, default, redirects {old URL → new URL}, workflows[{id music | sfx | voiceover | change-voice | translate | soundtrack-music | soundtrack-sound | cover, name, tool, mode (submit POST /api/tools/{tool}/jobs with types=["{mode}"], quote GET /api/tools/{tool}/price?mode={mode}), runner {kind audio, toolId}, defaults {local, hosted, hostedFallback?, why, active} (shared/audioDefaults.ts), slots[{name, label, required, sendsAs, order, hint, missing}], oneOf?, groups, controls, prompt {mode, placeholder}, lyrics {mode required | optional | hidden, placeholder, requiredFor[]} (job field lyrics, read by every music model), models {mode: provider ids}, modelInfo {providerId: {name, workflow {line, url, source}}}, output {kind, count}, generateLabel, aliases, route}]}. ETag and max-age=60.

3D page (2026-10-23, shared/threeD.ts): {categories, default image-to-3d, redirects, bigGlbBytes, workflows[{id image-to-3d | turntable | plan-a-shot | text-to-3d | multiview-to-3d | retexture | rig, name, tagline, needs, status ready | soon, toolId, mode, how, route, runnable, defaults {local, hosted, hostedFallback, why, active}}], models[{id, name, place comfy | fal | local, detail, texture, faces, seed, symmetry, formats, defaults, licence, download?, priceNote}], showcase {dataset (Scenario 3D Collection, CC BY 4.0), items[{model, glb, preview, input}]}}. Roadmap rows are never runnable.
What a 3D result (GLB) holds, from its JSON chunk: {bytes, faces, vertices, meshes, textured, pbr, materials, images, valid, big}. url must be /files/<name>.glb (400 otherwise, 404 when missing).

Image to layers: the composite of every layer in order (the card poster). Made once when the job finished; for older jobs it is made on this first request. Redirects (302) to the PNG under /files; the job carries layersPosterUrl. 404 when the job is not a finished layered result.

post.summary: Direct a Shot, your 3D models (shared/previzModels.ts): upload a GLB of your own: multipart model (glTF 2.0 binary with at least one mesh, at most 40 MB) → {ok, url: /files/up-<hash>.glb, name, bytes}. 413 too_large; 400 bad_glb with the problem in plain words.

Rig as a character (shared/previzRig.ts): keep a character rigged in the browser (Mesh2Motion human skeleton + CC0 moves) as a 3D result, free: multipart model (rigged GLB: a skin and at least one animation, at most 40 MB), meta (JSON RigMeta: moves, clips, timings, src, srcJob), optional poster (PNG) → {ok, id, url, bytes, posterUrl}. The job is tool three-d, provider local-rig, parentId = the source 3D job. 413 too_large; 400 bad_glb / bad_meta.

get.summary: Direct a Shot, your 3D models: the GLBs you uploaded, newest first → {uploads: [{url, name, bytes, at}]}.

post.summary: Save the still the 3D viewer rendered as the card poster of a finished 3D job: multipart image (PNG / JPEG / WebP, at most 8 MB) → {ok, posterUrl}; the job carries threeD.posterUrl and outputs[0].posterUrl. 404 when the job is not a finished 3D result.

get.summary: Image presets (shared/presets.ts): saved recipes, one workflow each. {categories[Scene | Style | Look | Light | People | Product | Camera], presets[{id, name, workflow (create-image or a GET /api/image-workflows id), category, description, promptTemplate ({subject} / {prompt} = the user's text), subjectHint, settings {field: value} (the runner tool's real fields; lists as arrays), lora {name, strength, url, licence} | null, thumbnail (web path) | null, thumbnailModel (what made it) | null, hero, available (false = workflow not wired into Create Image yet), inspiredBy[] (plain notes), runner {toolId}, workflowStatus ready | soon, ready (available and pickable now), href (the Create Image link that opens it: /image?workflow=<id>&preset=<id>)}]}. Presets never pick the model. Checked at boot; a preset with an unknown workflow, field or value is logged and left out. Quote with GET /api/tools/{runner.toolId}/price and the settings. Cache-friendly: ETag and max-age=60; If-None-Match → 304.

Image features (transparency): each feature with its defaults {local, hosted, why, note?} (per-workflow default models), its plain name (Create Image, Edit Image, Upscale, Relight, Face Swap, Person Swap, Camera Angles, Camera & Lens, Brush Edit, Character Sheet, Product Shot), page URL, inMenu (false for Edit Image: it lives inside Create Image), the toolId it runs on, old names and URLs, our recipe, and models[{providerId, model (real name), supports {aspects, allowAuto, resolutions, qualityTiers, maxImages, minImages, mask, strength, seed, maxCount}, workflow {source: official | community | ours, name, url, author, licence, file?, recipe}}]: only models that really work for that feature.
One of our ComfyUI graphs from workflows/ (API format), the target of an "Ours" workflow credit. 400 for a name that is not a plain *.json file, 404 when it does not exist.

delete.summary: Remove a workflow you added (file = its id): out of the app and its folder deleted. 404 unknown, 403 for folders that ship with the app.

get.summary: Tool registry: inputs, presets, providers (with licences; each provider carries displayName, providerGroup "Local" | "Comfy Cloud" | "API" and runsOnKind, the same values as /api/models and /api/routes), media, badge, posterUrl Includes compatibility tools with listed:false. New discovery must omit those entries; explicit legacy tool IDs, REST clients and historical jobs remain supported. Object / Person Swap uses object-swap; two-person-swap is history/compatibility-only, not a new workflow choice. Apps with clip lengths (Camera Moves, Photo FX) carry app.durationsByProvider {providerId: number[]} and app.defaultDurationByProvider {providerId: number}: local graphs use the app list (Camera Moves 3/5 s on Wan Fun Camera, LTX-2 and the H3 camera LoRA; Photo FX 5 s), hosted models their own list (Veo 4/6/8, Kling 3–15, Seedance 4–15). Same lists on providers[].durations and /api/routes; anything else → 400 invalid_duration on quote and submit. Comfy Router on the video apps (2026-10-22): Camera Moves, Photo FX and Orbit Shot run on Seedance 2.0 (router-seedance) and MiniMax H3 (api-minimax-h3) through Comfy Router: the move / effect / orbit becomes our prompt recipe and the photo the first frame (centre-cropped to a picked aspect; auto = the photo as it is); one photo only (extra reference images → the route refuses the job before anything is charged); 4–15 s; Seedance 480p / 720p / 1080p, MiniMax H3 768P (480p / 720p) or 2K (1080p, priced as 2K). Kling v3 (Router schema without an image input) and Veo 3.1 are not listed on these apps; Kling is text-to-video only on Generate Video (app.providerModes) and not listed on Object Swap / Motion Transfer. providers[].workflow on these pairs = the workflow credit {source:"official", name, url, author, licence, recipe}; job.feature = {label:"Camera Moves · Seedance 2.0", workflow} for their jobs. DP #20 (Oct 19): every tool carries allowed {resolution: string[], aspect: string[], quality: string[] (the tool's own quality values, e.g. low/med/high), qualityLabels: string[] (same order, e.g. Low/Medium/High), qualityAliases: string[] (resolution values also accepted as quality), scale: string[], types: string[] | null, mode: string[] | null}: the effective enum allowlists the quote and submit enforce (shared/enumParams.ts). [] = the tool takes no value for that field (sending one is a 400); types/mode null = any plain id (letters, digits, - _ : .), for tools whose types are not a fixed list (Object Swap, Restyle, …). types/mode: an empty value or [] counts as not sent. DP #21 (Oct 19): Photo FX has an aspect input (options = union; byProvider: local graph auto | 16:9 | 9:16 | 1:1, auto = 16:9 landscape; partner models their own lists) and tool.allowed.aspect; another value → 400 with a code. Anime Restyle: app.gallery.lockedStyle {field:"preset", id:"anime-cel", label, description, group, posterUrl, previewWebm}. Transitions (and Orbit Shot): the prompt input is required:false (the app composes the prompt). Per-option media on app.gallery.fields[].options for Orbit Shot orbit, Transitions transition, UGC Ad presenter and Relight direction: posterUrl, loopUrl (string | null; /examples/options/<app>/<field>-<value>.jpg|.mp4 once the file exists in web/public/examples) and needsRealPoster (true until then); poster / preview mirror them. Change Voice: the built-in voice choice carries sampleUrl (/examples/voice/builtin.mp3 when present) or null + needsSample:true; sampleKind 'standin' unless examples/voice/<value>.json says {"kind":"real"}. Relight lightX / lightY: numbers in −1…1 (final), both or neither: one alone → 400 code required, outside the range → 400 code out_of_range. BH12 / DP #22 (Oct 19): an aspect is checked per engine where the tool lists aspect byProvider (Photo FX, Camera Moves): the local graph's list or the partner model's own; another value → 400 {code:"unsupported_aspect", field:"aspect", allowed (that engine's list), provider} on the quote and on submit, so price and job follow the same engine. An app that locks a value (UGC Ad aspect 9:16) has allowed.aspect = ["9:16"]; a well-formed aspect not on that list (16:9) → 400 unsupported_aspect {code, field:"aspect", allowed}; a malformed aspect (zzq) → 400 invalid_aspect (never silently replaced); its mock output is 720×1280. Relight lightX / lightY: −1…1 is final; the quote checks it like submit (one alone → 400 code required; outside → 400 out_of_range). Change Voice (app-change-voice, Voice Studio change-voice): a file field audio (audio/*) instead of video → the changed voice as an audio file in outputFormat (MP3 by default), same length; the app needs a video or an audio file (required [[video, audio]]); with neither → 400 required "Add a video or an audio clip.". Oct 19: the Change Voice built-in voice choice (inputs voice → choices value builtin) carries sampleKind "real" | "standin" and sampleIsStandIn (boolean) next to sampleUrl / needsSample. "real" only when a sidecar web/public/examples/voice/<value>.json says {"kind":"real"} and the clip is a recording of the built-in Chatterbox voice; any other clip (or none) is "standin". B6: providers[] are in quality order (best first). Tool: preferredProvider (quality pick = qualityOrder[0]), defaultProvider (saved pin when it runs, else, on an image tool, the default chosen for that workflow and the active setup when it runs (shared/imageDefaults.ts: local when Use local is on and it runs, else hosted), else the first model that really runs with the current keys and settings, a local route only when Use local is on / pinned / no cloud model, else the first model that only lacks a key, else preferredProvider), defaultRoute, defaultFallback (null when default = preferred, else {note, from, to, fromName, toName, reasonCode: key_missing | not_wired | local_off | local_unreachable | open_weights_only | input_blocked | no_price | coming_soon | mode_unsupported | not_runnable | pinned}), defaultState, qualityOrder, defaultsByMode {mode: {preferredProvider, defaultProvider, defaultRoute, defaultFallback, qualityOrder, editorialDefault?}}, editorialDefault (image tools: {feature, local, hosted, id (the default for the active setup), setup local | hosted, runs, reason (why it can't run, else null), why (one line), source pin | editorial | fallback}), workflowDefaults {featureId: {preferredProvider, defaultProvider, defaultRoute, defaultFallback, qualityOrder, editorialDefault}} (every image feature the tool runs; Create Image: create-image, edit-image, camera-lens), twinAliases {cardId: {model, route, tools}} (Comfy Cloud twin cards are routes of their open model; the cards stay in providers[] with twinOf {model, route, tools} and qualityRank null, never in qualityOrder, still accepted as provider=). Each provider: qualityRank, runnable (real run now), demoPreview, needsKey (a key would make it run for real), keyOwner, wired, hasCloud, reasonCode, reason, statusRoute, pinned. object-swap: swapTypes {person|object: {preferredProvider, defaultProvider, defaultRoute, defaultFallback, qualityOrder, models[{id, name, ...provider status}]}}. DP #27 (Oct 19): Restyle presets[] carry loopUrl, loopPlaceholder, needsRealLoop and standIn (same fields as /api/posters Restyle style slots). Providers with demoPreview also carry demoTag "Sample". Change Voice builtin sampleUrl is also on GET /api/apps (inputOptions.voice) and GET /api/voices (sampleUrl on every non-clone voice). HW-SHAPES: providers[] carry fit {verdict, reasonCode} | null (local fit on this computer); model status reasonCode may be too_heavy ("is too heavy for this computer: <fit.reason>") when every local route is too heavy. The hardware tier itself is on GET /api/hardware (local {…} keeps its shape). dp30 (g): defaultFallback.note for reasonCode too_heavy passes through the fit's own reason: "<model> is too heavy for this computer: <fit.reason>, so <default> is the default.", or "<model> is too heavy for this computer, so …" when the fit has no reason. Step 1: each tool also carries models[] (one row per MODEL; providers[] unchanged): {key, name, family, medium, openWeights, license {id, name, url, osi}, blurb, blurbKey, note?, engines [old provider ids], primaryEngine, isDefault, state ("ready" | "sample" | "needs-key" | "not-installed" | "coming-soon" | "unavailable"), fromPrice (credits, cheapest ready/sample run-on for a default job; 0 when Local is ready), fromPriceUnit, runsOn [{id, label, billedTo, status ("ready" | "sample" | "needs-key" | "off" | "not-installed" | "coming-soon" | "unavailable"), credits (list price for a default job; 0 local), reason, reasonCode, routes [routeId], engines, comfyVariants?}], autoRunOn, lifecycle, lifecycleNote}. Endpoint variants (fal t2v / i2v / references) are one fal row. Each providers[] entry also carries modelKey. Run on (2026-10-22): models[] carry preselect {runOn, label, status, action} | null (the place a model with no saved choice runs on: first ready Comfy → other API (cheapest) → Local, else the mock sample, else null: a place that needs a download, a key or a switch is never pre-selected), autoRunOn (= preselect.runOn, kept for older clients), setup [{runOn, label, action, credits}] (the places that could be set up, same order; Local credits 0 = free per run once set up), rowStatus {kind ready | sample | add_key | download | turn_on | install_node | set_up | coming_soon | unavailable, text, runOn, credits} (one status per picker row) and fromPrice (ready / sample places only; null when nothing runs; an uninstalled GPU is never free); each runsOn row carries group (gpu | comfy | api), detail ("Comfy Cloud" / "Comfy Router" on the Comfy row) and action {kind turn_on | download | install_node | add_key | set_up_gpu, text, missingBytes?, downloadId?} | null; the Local row adds missingBytes when its files don't fit on the disk (reasonCode not_enough_disk). Model catalogue (2026-10-22, shared/modelRank.ts): every models[] row also carries displayName (name with version, e.g. "Seedance 2.0"), bestFor (one plain line: what the model is good at), rank (per medium, lower = higher; API models before Local models), home ("api" | "gpu"), featured, popular (editorial), aliases (search words), releasedAt (sourced date or null), maker / makerName, caps {summary, …} (image: maxResolution, maxRefs, edit, mask; video: maxResolution, minSeconds, maxSeconds, sound; audio: kind), variantOf and variants (model keys: Z-Image ↔ Z-Image-Turbo). GET /api/models/registry models[] carry the same block as catalogue. Models not on Comfy Router (HY Image 3.5, Muse Image, Fish Audio S2.1 Pro, Sonilo, HeyGen Voice) are Coming soon in every mode. Picker sections (2026-10-22, MODEL-PICKER-REVIEW task 5): every models[] row also carries section ("featured": the catalogue featured API models, at most 5 per list, never retiring; "api"; "gpu": best place is your own computer; "soon": nothing can run it here yet) and isNew (releasedAt within 60 days). Rows come sorted by section, then rank, then name; status never reorders them.

Pre-flight: every reason a run can't start yet, ordered inputs → model → setup → money, each with one fix. Query = the /price query (provider, types, controls, image=1 / face=1 for filled slots, refs, mask=1, shots) plus photoWidth / photoHeight (the photo in the image slot) and prompt or hasPrompt=1. Returns {ok, problems[{code, stage inputs | model | setup | money, message, fix {kind, label, args}, alt?}], quote} where quote is GET /api/tools/{toolId}/price unchanged (quote = charge). Codes: photo_missing, photo_too_small, photo_shape (fix fit-photo {slot, aspect}, alt crop-photo), too_many_images (use-first {n}, alt pick-model), mask_missing, prompt_missing, pick_missing, model_cant_run, price_unavailable, needs_key, needs_download ({runOn, bytes}), needs_gpu, needs_node, needs_setup, over_limit. A photo_shape fix is done by the client (the bar fits or crops the photo, then uploads that); the submit then checks the photo's real shape. Spends nothing.

Price for a setup (credits, breakdown). seconds (alias duration) uses the same resolver as job submit; outside the model videoCaps min/maxSeconds → 400 issues[field=seconds] Oct 18 batch 3. Every quote: unit, unitLabel, unitHelp at top level (null on local routes) and hosted for the route that would run (also demo / needsKey); chargeable (true only when runnable, not a demo and credits > 0). runnable:false for any reason other than a missing key (not_wired, coming soon, unreachable, a job the route refuses): credits null, priceAvailable false, chargeable false, listCredits = list price, priceLine (e.g. "Comfy API (partner node) isn't available on this server yet. List price 212 credits ($2.12)."), unavailableReason; quote text never says "Nothing was charged" (the submit 409/402 does). needsKey quotes also carry keyOwner. Camera Moves: Auto with an H3-only move quotes H3 Camera Motion; no image (no image=1) on an image-only model → 400 image_required also when a model is chosen; a move the chosen model can't run → 400 unsupported (same bodies as submit). Translate (Voice Studio types=translate, Translate Video): language must be voiced by the chosen translate route, Auto picks the first that does; else 400 unsupported_language {languages, languagesByProvider, providers}. Upscale with sourceResolution= (or width/height): sourceSize, sourceResolution, scale, outputSize, estimated false unless seconds are missing (then estimateReason clip_not_loaded). Input prep (2026-10-23): an edit on a model whose edits follow the photo (FLUX 3 Klein, FLUX.2 klein 4B, FLUX.2 dev, Qwen-Image) quotes a picked or locked aspect (Character Sheet 4:3) when photoAspect says the photo already has that shape (1% either way); the submit checks the uploaded photo's real shape the same way. A route that lacks its provider key (asked with ?route= / runOn, or a saved pin) quotes runnable:false, needsKey:true, keyMissing:true, credits = listCredits = the price once the key is added (not a charge) and priceLine "Needs a <provider> key. Price once it's added: N credits ($x)." With no place asked for and none ready, nothing is pre-selected: runnable:false, runOn / route / credits null, setup (the first place to set up) and setupOptions [{runOn, runOnLabel, routeId, action, actionText, credits, missingBytes?, downloadId?, slow?}] in the order Comfy → other API → Local (credits = the price per run once set up; Local 0). On the mock backend a keyless route quotes as a sample run instead. ?route= without provider quotes the model that owns that route. Video upscale tools without width/height assume a 720p 16:9 source (sourceResolution= overrides) even when seconds is given: estimated:true, estimateReason source_size_unknown (or clip_not_loaded), assumedSize/assumedScale/assumedOutputSize. Quotes carry `local` (true only when the chosen route is local); on a cloud route free/basis/breakdown describe that route, even for open-weights models. Carries fallback (FallbackNotice | null), same as /api/models/quote. Demo contract: routeId (the route Auto/pin would actually run), runnable (boolean), demo (boolean), demoMessage (string | null, e.g. "Sample output, nothing billed."), demoNotice ({code:"demo_preview", routeId, message} | null), listCredits (demo only: the route's real price, for display). A demo preview is FREE: credits 0, charge 0, no ledger debit. Auto picks only runnable, non-demo routes; a demo preview is offered only when none exists (mock backend). Apps (app-*) are quoted with their locked params. Carries demo; noProvider carries state/options/title/message. Real mode with nothing set up: state = "needs_provider" with options ⊆ ["connect_key","enable_local"], title and message (calm setup copy) next to the existing noProvider fields (error, errorType no_provider, providers, localRoute). state = "ready" when a route resolves. MiniMax H3 models (768p/480p tiers, e.g. cloud-h3-wf): resolution=720p is mapped to 768p; the quote then carries resolution "768p" and resolutionMapped {from, to, message}, and the job is charged the same (its warnings carry the message). Oct 19 input blocks: when the route can't run THIS job because of its inputs (mode / a missing or extra input; reasonCode "input_blocked"), the quote keeps the real price: credits = listCredits = the price, priceAvailable:true, chargeable:false, runnable:false, blockedReason (plain sentence), blockedCode:"input_blocked", priceLine = the normal price line; no unavailableReason. Route-level reasons (not_wired, coming soon, unreachable, local_off, no price) keep credits:null, priceAvailable:false, unavailableReason. Edit Video menu routes carry the same blockedReason. Oct 19 enum params: resolution, aspect (alias aspectRatio), quality and scale are checked on quote AND submit against the tool's allowlist (its input options; resolution also every resolution its models list; quality also accepts the resolution values, an existing alias; scale also the app scales; an app also its own app.resolutions / resolutionsByProvider; an app without a list of its own uses its base tool's; case-insensitive and normalised to the listed value; a tool with no list for a field takes no value for it: any value → 400 with allowed [] and "<Field> isn't a setting for this tool"; an empty value is not sent; apps check the user's values before their locked params apply. The effective lists are on /api/tools tool.allowed) → 400 {error, errorType:"validation", code:"invalid_<field>", field, allowed, issues}. Translate: an unknown language code → 400 code "invalid_language" (field language, plain message, the code is not echoed). Upscale: width+height of a real clip → sourceSize, sourceResolution (short side), scale, outputSize, sizeEstimated:false (as with ?sourceResolution=); no size → assumedSize…, sizeEstimated:true. Oct 19 b2: a runnable quote on a local route while Use local ComfyUI is off says why it runs: reasonCode "local_pinned" (route= or a saved pin) or "local_only" (no cloud route), with reason and localNote (same sentences as /api/routes). Camera: a move that needs a start image, quoted without one (image=1 absent), is a priced input block (200: runnable:false, chargeable:false, priceAvailable:true, reasonCode/blockedCode "input_blocked", blockedReason, blockedField/missingInput "image", submitCode "image_required", textProviders); submit still answers 400 image_required. A move the chosen model can't run keeps the 400. Validation on quote AND submit: resolution / aspect / quality / scale outside the tool's list, or sent to a tool with no list for it (allowed: []), → 400 invalid_<field>; an app with no list of its own uses its base tool's; quality errors list labels for the quality values only ("Pick Low, Medium or High.", allowed = machine values, allowedLabels; resolution aliases still accepted); types / mode → 400 invalid_type / invalid_mode (allowed = the list; the value is never echoed; a tool without a list accepts plain ids only); width / height → 400 invalid_size unless a whole number 16..16384 ({min, max}). Re-check 6: enum values (types, mode, quality, resolution, aspect, scale; also the upscale result action mode) are matched case-insensitively and normalised to the listed value on quote AND submit (types=GENERATE runs as generate). Quality also takes its labels (Low / Medium / High → low / med / high). A tool with no quality values of its own accepts only its resolution aliases; anything else → 400 invalid_quality, allowed [], "Quality isn't a setting for this tool. Leave it out." Every 4xx from a quote, a submit or a job action carries code (issues[0].code, else from errorType: invalid_input, insufficient_credits, no_provider, route_not_runnable). Re-shoot batch quote. B6: no provider = the tool defaultProvider (mode-aware). Success and error quotes carry preferredProvider, defaultProvider, defaultFallback; success quotes carry routeLabel, routeTier, routeTierLabel. Keyless demo quotes: routeLabel = demoLabel ("… · sample run · needs a <owner> key for real runs"), keyNeededForRealRuns, keyOwner, demoReason; needsKey stays false (a demo preview runs). GPT Image: quality low | med | high sets the request quality and the price. DP #27 (Oct 19): a quote with ?provider= (or /api/models/quote?model=) still carries preferredProvider, defaultProvider and defaultFallback (same as the general quote). A well-formed but disallowed aspect → 400 unsupported_aspect {field, allowed, provider} on quote and submit (UGC Ad, Photo FX, Camera); malformed → invalid_aspect. Keyless demo quotes carry demoTag "Sample" next to demoLabel/demoReason. HW-SHAPES: a quote on a local route also carries fit {verdict "fits" | "slow" | "too_heavy" | "unknown", reasonCode (fits | offload | mps | cpu | no_gpu | not_enough_vram | not_enough_ram | unsupported_weights | comfy_too_old | hardware_unknown | requirements_unknown | no_gpu_needed | not_enough_disk), hardwareReasonCode (the hardware reason when reasonCode is not_enough_disk), reason (plain), tier, enforced (false for unknown: nothing is blocked), lighterVariantAvailable, recommendedVramGB, effectiveVramGB (null when the hardware couldn't be read), etaSeconds (null when no estimate), eta {source "learned" | "estimate", samples, hwKey, estimateSeconds, learnedSeconds}, missingBytes, missingBytesSource "checked" | "assumed_all", downloadId (POST /api/local/downloads {downloadId}), diskFreeBytes, blockers[{code not_enough_disk, needBytes, freeBytes}] (only from checked files), vramFreeHint, variant? parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Same key + same request within 24 h returns the original response again (body idempotentReplay: true and response header Idempotent-Replayed: true, exposed via Access-Control-Expose-Headers): no second job, hold or charge. Aliases: header Client-Job-Id / X-Client-Job-Id, multipart field clientJobId or idempotencyKey (the key itself is not part of the compared request). Concurrent duplicates wait for the first and get its response. Same key + different body or endpoint → 409 exactly {"error":"idempotency_conflict","code":"idempotency_conflict","message":"This request was already sent with different details. Start a new one."}. Refused requests (4xx/5xx) are not remembered, so a fixed request can reuse the key.

schema.description: Multipart form. Which fields apply depends on the tool (see GET /api/tools → inputs).

refs.description: Reference images (PNG/JPG/WEBP/GIF). Up to 30 for swap tools (groups of ≤ 8), 5 × 64 MB for Restyle.

Only files recorded on that job (/files or /samples), copied under the new job id. A field you also upload keeps the upload. 400 {issues}: reuseInputs field not a file input of the tool (field reuseInputs), nothing_to_reuse (field = that input), fromJob not found; nothing is charged.

get.summary: Job list (not trashed). Default newest first. state=active (queued+running+needs_decision) or status=a,b → oldest first, each with percent, queuePos, updatedAt, slow, requeuedAt, groups, failedGroups. Job objects carry `enhanced: boolean`. Lists never include trashed jobs, in either order. ?ids= answers trashed jobs too, with deletedAt set, so a page can drop them. B7: job items carry owner and isOwner (false on other people's results: hide owner-only actions). Jobs carry fallback (FallbackNotice | null): route_failed / route_chosen after a route move during the run, else model_unavailable / pin_invalid decided at submit. Blender open-movie samples (CC BY 3.0) carry a visible label: sampleLabel = "Sample · CC-BY Blender Foundation" (else null) and sample = {label, film, credit, license, licenseUrl, sourceUrl, modified}; outputs[].sample per output (docs/ATTRIBUTION.md "Sample media"). Jobs also carry demo (null or the demo_preview notice the job ran under). Jobs carry diagnostics[] separately from outputs[]: optional auxiliary mask-selection/edit previews with label, stage, note, url and job/request/route/pass/node provenance. These silent previews are not generated results or effective sampler tensors. Masked H3 swap preview encoding adds unmeasured Cloud overhead. Never use a diagnostic as the primary result. Items carry posterUrl (string | null: an interim AI still for the demo sample jobs demo01–09 at /examples/assets/<id>.jpg once it exists; null → use the output media) and caption (string | null).

A place the user picked never moves on its own (unless allowFallback=1). When it can't move on, the failed job carries tryOn [{runOn, runOnLabel, routeId, credits, listCredits, demo, rank}] = the other places of its model that are ready now (pre-selection order); POST /api/jobs/{id}/retry {runOn} re-runs it there, pinned. Only a request that set allowFallback=1: B6 retry rule: after a failed attempt allowFallback continues only to a route whose price ≤ the quoted price (attempt 1). Otherwise status needs_decision with decision {reason: next_route_costs_more | queue_busy, quotedCredits, failedRoute, options[{routeId, label, credits, deltaCredits, tier, tierLabel}], note}, alternatives (+deltaCredits), refund/creditsBack for the failed attempt; continue with POST /api/jobs/{id}/fallback. busyNote {code: queue_busy, route, nextRoute, nextCredits, willSwitch, message} when a busy queue moved the job (willSwitch true) or parked it (false). Filming mode (fallbackOffers off) keeps a plain failure. Sample truth (agents): isSample (boolean, true = nothing real was generated or billed: a keyless place run as a preview, a mock run, or the mock backend) and sampleReason (string | null, the sentence to tell the user). place {runOn, label} (label as the app shows it, e.g. "Comfy · Comfy Router"). spend {billedTo, billedToName, estUsd, estUnits?, unitLabel? (Comfy / BFL credits), estimated, actualUsd (null until the provider reports it), actualSource, countedUsd, simulated, demo} | null (this endpoint only, not the list). The slow hint counts from the end of loading_model. Step 2: modelKey (stable model key; null for an unknown engine), runOn (the account the route that ran bills; a fallback updates it) and runOnLabel. `model` stays the display name of the engine that ran. Older jobs get them derived on read (nothing rewritten). post.summary: Retry download. A failed hosted job whose result was made (and paid for) but couldn't be saved, or whose provider stopped answering, polls the same request at its provider again (nothing is sent or charged again) and saves the result; `canCollect` on the job is true exactly then. 200 = the job, running again; 409 {code:nothing_to_collect} otherwise.

Cancel. Local (local ComfyUI) jobs can be canceled at every stage: waiting in this app's queue; submitted and pending in ComfyUI's own queue (removed from it, POST /queue delete); running (POST /interrupt, only when ComfyUI says the running prompt is this job's; nobody else's prompt is ever touched). 200 = the job, canceled (comfyCancel: removed | interrupted | not_in_queue | unreachable when a ComfyUI prompt was involved); nothing is billed. Finished first (or its last ComfyUI prompt already finished) → 409 {code:already_done}. `cancellable` on a job / queue activity item is true exactly when this call will succeed. Hosted single-group job whose request is at fal, Replicate, Comfy Router or Comfy Cloud → 200, the job canceled and the provider asked to cancel it; cancelNote says what that means for the bill (the provider's own rule: it may still bill the time it ran). Hosted single-group job on a lab API (no cancel call) already sent to its provider → 409 {code:cannot_cancel_processing, errorType:not_cancellable, cancelInProcessing:false, charged (boolean: cost > 0)} (error text mentions credits going back to your balance only when charged; a free gen says the free gen comes back; free / local jobs get plain wording) unless OPENHIGGSFIELD_CANCEL_IN_PROCESSING=1 (then real cancel, outputs discarded, credits back to your balance (team mode; with your own accounts the provider failure rule applies); anything the provider already billed is under its terms). Queued: instant cancel, credits back to your balance (team mode; with your own accounts the provider failure rule applies). Running chunked (multi-group) job: groups not yet started are skipped and their credits go back to your balance (team mode; with your own accounts the provider failure rule applies); finished groups are kept (canceledGroups)

Retry a FAILED or BLOCKED job (a provider refusal, errorType nsfw|ip): a new job with the same inputs (simulate cleared), with its own quote and charge on the same route; the credits of the original stay returned to your balance once. Returns {id, retryOf, parentId, cost, free, route?, balance}. A second call while that retry is alive returns the same id (idempotentReplay:true). Done/queued/running/canceled → 409 {code:"not_failed", state}; 402 {code:"credits"} when unaffordable. failedOnly=1: re-run only the failed ref groups as a child job (parentId) Run on (2026-10-22): body or query runOn re-runs the job on that place (the failed job's tryOn lists the ready ones with their price); invalid ids answer 400 invalid_run_on, nothing charged. Every retry (plain, runOn, failedOnly) is checked like a submit (agent budget); it gets its own Spend row (reply estimate). The new job carries rerun: retry | try-on | failed-groups and is not counted as enhanced.

Stitch clips into one video on this computer with ffmpeg (free, $0 in the spend log): JSON {clips: [job id or /files/ URL, …] (1–20, in order; each job's first video output), audio?: job id or /files/ URL (a music bed, trimmed to the video and faded out), voice?: job id or /files/ URL (a narration or dialogue track from 0 s, mixed over the music, which drops to musicVolume, default 0.25 with a voice), musicVolume? (0–2), keepClipAudio? (true: keep each clip's own sound, joined in order, under the music and voice; default false), layout?: "sequence" (default) or "side-by-side" (exactly 2 clips next to each other, e.g. before/after; as long as the shorter one), aspect?: e.g. "9:16", "1:1", "4:5" (centre-crops the result: free cutdowns), title?, fadeOutSec? (0–5, default 1), videoFade? (true: the picture and every sound fade to black over fadeOutSec at the end; default false = only the music fades), trims?: [{in?, out?} | null, …] (seconds, one per clip in clip order, at most one per clip; null or {} = the whole clip; each trim is cut in that clip's own input and clamped to the clip, with a warning when one ran past the end; out must be ≥ 0.1 s after in). Editor fields (all optional): transition "cut" (default) | "crossfade" | "dip" (to black) with transitionSec (0.1–5, default 0.5, capped at 45 % of the shortest clip; each joint shortens the film by it); fit "fit" | "fill" | "blur" with cropX / cropY (0–1, fill's crop point): reframe to aspect from the first clip's short side (240–1080; without fit the older rule below stays); clipVolume / musicVolume / voiceVolume (0–2, gains on tracks first levelled to a set loudness; musicVolume defaults to 0.6 with a voice or clip sound, else 1); duck (default true: music and clip sound dip under the voice, a sidechain compressor) with duckAmount (0–1, default 0.6, about 11 dB); duckClips (default false: the music also dips under the clips' own sound when keepClipAudio; Film turns it on); seams: [{type "cut" | "crossfade" | "fade" (= "dip") | "jcut" | "lcut", sec?} | null, …] (Film: one transition per joint; jcut = a picture cut where the next clip's sound starts sec early, lcut = this clip's sound runs sec past the cut, each shortening the film by sec like a crossfade; seams[i] joins clip i and i+1, null = the film-wide transition; the result lists seams as applied); normalize (default true: every track levelled and the film set to −14 LUFS with a −1.5 dBTP limiter; false = the older raw mix); musicLoop (true: music shorter than the film loops); titleCard / endCard {text, style "clean" | "bold" | "quiet" | "lower", mode "black" (its own segment, adds sec) | "over" (over the first / last clip), sec 1–6 (default 2.5)}; endCard {} uses "Imagination is all you need.". Cards sent as text are drawn on the server; multipart instead of JSON (the JSON in a "body" field) can carry PNG parts titleCard / endCard (the film's size, transparent) and caption strips cue0…cueN with captions: [{start, end, y}] (seconds in the film, y in px).}. Without fit, clips are scaled and padded to the first clip's size at 30 fps (a 9:16 clip in a 16:9 film is pillarboxed, then aspect crops the whole film). Creates a done job (toolId "compose") that shows in Assets. Optional X-OHF-Agent-Budget: <agent budget id> (from POST /api/agent/budgets). Returns {id, toolId, status, outputs, resultUrl, durationSec, width, height, clips, music, voice, clipAudio, layout, aspect, trims ([{in, out} | null] as applied, null when nothing was cut), videoFade, transition, transitionSec, overlapSec, fit, crop, mix, titleCard, endCard, captions, ducked, loudness {before, target, levels}, warnings, cost: 0, agent}.

errorType.description: nsfw / ip = the cloud provider refused the job (never an app-side filter)

Output.description: B5: kind/width/height/durationSec/posterUrl are added from ffprobe (cached per file); null until probed (a single GET /api/jobs/{id} or /api/share/{token} waits for the probe).

posterUrl.description: video: sibling .jpg or /api/media/poster?url=…; image: its own url; audio: null

progress.description: 0–100 (kept for compatibility; progressInfo is the shared progress story)

calibrating.description: true when this local run is the first timed run of its workflow on this computer (no estimate was shown; it calibrates the next ones)

reasonCode.description: BH9: why a Comfy Cloud or Comfy Router run failed: key_invalid | cloud_credits | cloud_plan (no API access on the Comfy plan, or Router not enabled: 403 forbidden / not_enabled) | content_blocked | input_invalid | model_unavailable | provider_error | price_changed (Router estimate above the accepted quote; nothing dispatched) | workflow_invalid | queue_full | submit_uncertain | cloud_job_failed | cloud_timeout | cloud_unreachable | content_blocked | cloud_job_gone (B7, Oct 19: the Comfy Cloud job disappeared mid-run; full refund) | upload_failed (Comfy Cloud refused the input upload; nothing was submitted)

cloudJobId.description: Comfy Cloud v2 job id (stored at submit; never resubmitted)

routerRequestId.description: Comfy Router queued request id (POST /v2/models/{provider}/{model}/requests; stored at submit, only ever polled). For a synchronous Router run, its X-Comfy-Request-Id.

providerError.description: When a Comfy Router or Comfy Cloud run failed: what Comfy / the model provider said, sanitised (no keys, local paths, signed-link queries or inline media). {errorType, httpStatus, upstreamStatus, detail, upstreamDetail, refusalSubject, requestId, model, at}; Comfy Cloud adds step (upload | submit | job) and nodeErrors (one line per node error of a refused graph)

modelName.description: BH9 (a): model that actually ran when it differs from the card (Camera Moves LTX presets → LTX-2 19B)

ProgressInfo.description: Shared progress for every runner (progress.ts). One label source: stage + step/steps (no duplicate counters). Per source: local-comfy = ComfyUI websocket (queued in ComfyUI's own queue with queuePosition → loading (model load / text encode, no step yet) → generating with step/steps, percent from steps and etaSeconds from the step-ETA → finishing (decode, save) + previewUrl when a live frame exists); comfy-cloud = job status (queued → generating, percent only when Comfy Cloud reports a value → finishing); comfy-router / fal / replicate / bfl = status only (queued with the provider's queuePosition when it reports one → generating → finishing); mock = simulated values (sample runs).

percent.description: only when really known (sampler steps, Comfy Cloud progress value, simulated on mock)

etaSeconds.description: seconds left from the step-ETA (local runs); absent otherwise

queuePosition.description: queued: place in line, 1 = next (the app queue; once running, ComfyUI's or the provider's own queue when known)

EtaRange.description: Step-ETA (stepEta.ts) for a local ComfyUI run, learned on this computer only: seconds = load (cold or warm, whichever applies now) + steps × learned seconds per step + post/decode. Seconds per step scales with pixels × frames × batch × (2 when cfg > 1), so one timed run also estimates other step counts and sizes of the same workflow (source scaled, wider range). low/high come from the spread of the timed runs (narrower as runs add up). source learned | scaled | reported (no timed run yet; a published figure for this GPU class, ×0.7–1.4) | first_run (no number: this run is timed). null on cloud routes.

includesLoad.description: the model-load time included: cold (not loaded yet) or warm (the same model files ran in the last 10 minutes)

key.description: workflow key: hash of workflow + model files + LoRA count | pixels×frames×batch | cfg

FallbackNotice.description: Model-fallback notice (routing/fallback.ts). null = ran as asked. Codes: model_unavailable (requestedModel not offered here: hidden in open-weights-only mode, not on this tool, or unknown; the client sent another model, e.g. Recreate prefill), pin_invalid (saved per-model route no longer serves the model, Auto picked), route_failed (a route failed mid-run and Auto / allowFallback moved the job; credits of the failed attempt back to your balance), route_chosen (pinned route failed → needs_decision → POST /api/jobs/{id}/fallback). The model is never swapped server-side.

costDiffers.description: null when the requested side has no price on this tool

requestedCredits.description: Requested route price for this job (route_*), or the requested model's cheapest priced route (model_unavailable)

usedCredits.description: What this job is charged (= job cost)

badge.description: One per tool. top = most jobs (fallback object-swap); new = addedAt within 7 days; free = a provider with priceFactor 0

freeGensCovered.description: Free gens can be used on this tool

freeGens.description: Free-gen allowance when covered, else null
